objective: Prove a genuine Euclidean heat-operator estimate on a specified function space: positivity and L-infinity contraction first, then L1 contraction or strong continuity with all measurability/integrability obligations, using Lebesgue measure and the explicit Gaussian kernel; one smoothing or differentiation-under-integral lemma if feasible; then design compact-manifold obligations explicitly.
target_statements: heatOperator n t f x = ∫ y, gaussianKernel n t (x - y) * f y  (def, D12 Basic)
positivity: 0 ≤ᵐ f → ∀x, 0 ≤ heatOperator n t f x for 0 < t (heatOperator_nonneg, PROVED)
L∞ contraction (pointwise): ∀y, ‖f y‖ ≤ M → ∀x, ‖heatOperator n t f x‖ ≤ M for 0 < t (heatOperator_norm_le_of_forall_norm_le, PROVED)
L1 contraction (lintegral form): ∫⁻ x, ‖P_t f x‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻ y, ‖f y‖ₑ for AEStronglyMeasurable f, 0 < t (PLANNED, L1Contraction.lean)
L1 contraction (real form): Integrable f → Integrable (P_t f) ∧ ∫ ‖P_t f‖ ≤ ∫ ‖f‖ (PLANNED, L1Contraction.lean)
L∞ contraction (Banach space): ‖P_t f‖ ≤ ‖f‖ for f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ᵇ ℝ (PLANNED, LinfContraction.lean, needs continuity of P_t f)
strong continuity at 0: Continuous f, Integrable f → Tendsto (t ↦ P_t f x) (𝕍[>] 0) (𝕍 (f x)) (via D11 flatKernel_tendsto_integral, PLANNED)
operator semigroup law: P_s (P_t f) = P_{s+t} f for Integrable f (PLANNED, Semigroup.lean, Fubini + D10 convolution identity)
smoothing: f bounded+measurable → x ↦ P_t f x is C¹ with explicit derivative ∫ ∇_x K(x,y) f(y) dy (PLANNED, Smoothing.lean, via hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le)
operator semigroup law: heatOperator n s (heatOperator n t f) x = heatOperator n (s+t) f x for Integrable f, 0<s, 0<t (heatOperator_comp_heatOperator, PROVED, Semigroup.lean)
semigroup law for uniformly bounded measurable f via DCT on ball truncations (heatOperator_comp_heatOperator_of_bounded, PROVED, Semigroup.lean)
BCF semigroup law: heatOperatorBCF n hs (heatOperatorBCF n ht f) = heatOperatorBCF n (add_pos hs ht) f (heatOperatorBCF_comp, PROVED, Semigroup.lean)

kernel-level L1 continuity: Tendsto (k ↦ ∫ z, |K_{s+u k} z - K_s z|) atTop (𝓝 0) for any u : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝[>] 0) (tendsto_integral_abs_gaussianKernel_sub_of_seq, PROVED, StrongContinuityL1.lean)
L1-strong continuity witness at 0⁺ for the Gaussian family: ∫ x, |P_{u k}(K_s(·-a)) x - K_s(x-a)| → 0 (heatOperator_gaussianKernel_L1_tendsto_seq, PROVED, StrongContinuityL1.lean)
approach: Define the heat operator directly against Lebesgue measure with the D10 gaussianKernel; reuse D10 mass/convolution and D11 flatKernel compatibility + weak initial condition; prove L1 via Tonelli in ENNReal (enorm API, hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm, lintegral_lintegral_swap, ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal) and L∞ via mass-1 comparison; smoothing via mathlib dominated-differentiation lemma; non-vacuity via the Gaussian self-reproduction example P_t K_s(·-a) = K_{t+s}(·-a) using the D10 convolution identity.
